items.prompt: Write 2–3 sentences about your favorite hobby. Say what it is, how often you do it, and why you enjoy it.
items.answer: I love playing basketball. I play it every weekend with my friends at the park.

items.prompt: Describe a recent trip or outing you took. Include where you went, who was with you, and one thing that surprised you.
items.answer: Last month I went to the beach with my family. We swam in the ocean and built sandcastles. I was surprised to see dolphins jumping near the shore!

items.prompt: Some people think technology makes us more connected; others say it makes us more isolated. Write a short paragraph giving your opinion and one reason.
items.answer: I think technology makes us more connected because we can talk to people anywhere instantly. But it is important to also spend time with people face to face.

items.prompt: Read this short text and then rewrite it using different words while keeping the same meaning: 'The weather was very hot, so we decided to stay inside and watch a movie.'
items.answer: It was extremely warm outside, so we chose to remain indoors and watch a film.

items.prompt: Complete the following sentence in a natural way, using at least one conditional form: 'If I had more free time, ...'
items.answer: If I had more free time, I would travel to different countries and learn about their cultures.
